content: ESA - 20 years of Mars Express: Mars as never seen before Science & Exploration 20 years of Mars Express: Mars as never seen before 02/06/2023 49791 views 391 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express A new mosaic of Mars marks 20 years since the launch of ESA's Mars Express , and reveals the planet’s colour and composition in spectacular detail. The mosaic was created using data from Mars Express’s High Resolution Stereo Camera (HRSC) . HRSC normally photographs Mars’s surface from an altitude of about 300 km – the closest the spacecraft gets to Mars in its elliptical orbit – with the resulting images covering areas about 50 km across.
